title: Support allows an unfamiliar place nearby

captions.energy: Securing a special place through need

meaning: Your involvement can become freer when wanting to be indispensable allows another, still unfamiliar way of remaining close.
text: Being nearby need not mean only being the person who knows how to help. In the physical position of Anahata, the Chariot expresses care through active involvement across a difficulty. The Devil in energy brings a wish to secure a special place through being needed. The Fool in emotions offers openness to an unknown experience. Tenderness can find another course when someone need not remain dependent on your usefulness. You can share the unknown without proving exceptional importance.

For example, you help the other person prepare a simple music recording and are then invited to try the instrument yourself. **Closeness can continue where you do not yet know how to be useful.** You can accept, begin awkwardly and avoid making it an examination. Earlier action already helped cross an obstacle. Another meeting now appears where attention is not purchased through indispensability. Tenderness means freedom to be a beginner beside someone instead of constantly earning care’s place as the person without whom everything stops.

Openness becomes a light appearance if your need for confirmation is merely joked away. You try something new while awaiting special recognition and resenting an ordinary answer. The former condition survives beneath another gesture. Warmth remains when help’s importance can be recognised without compulsory reward. A new experience need not restore your earlier place.
